metrics.append({'label':'Date range end (min parsed date, ISO)','value': float(df['Date'].max().timestamp()) if df['Date'].notna().any() else 0.0})

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

work = pd.DataFrame({
    "Units": pd.to_numeric(df["Units"], errors="coerce"),
    "UnitPrice": pd.to_numeric(df["UnitPrice"], errors="coerce"),
})
if "Market" in df.columns:
    work["Market"] = df["Market"].astype(str)
else:
    work["Market"] = "All"

mask = work["Units"].notna() & work["UnitPrice"].notna()
n_pairs = int(mask.sum())
n_excluded = int(len(work) - n_pairs)
x = work.loc[mask, "Units"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
y = work.loc[mask, "UnitPrice"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

def spearman_manual(a, b):
    ra = pd.Series(a).rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    rb = pd.Series(b).rank(method="average").to_numpy()
    return float(np.corrcoef(ra, rb)[0, 1])

rho = spearman_manual(x, y) if n_pairs > 1 else float("nan")
pearson = float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]) if n_pairs > 1 else float("nan")
p_value = None
kendall = None
try:
    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr, kendalltau
    rho_s, p_s = spearmanr(x, y)
    rho = float(rho_s)
    p_value = float(p_s)
    pearson = float(pearsonr(x, y)[0])
    kendall = float(kendalltau(x, y)[0])
except Exception:
    pass

metrics = [
    {"label": "Spearman rank correlation (rho) between Units and UnitPrice, complete pairs only", "value": rho},
    {"label": "Complete Units-UnitPrice pairs analysed (rows with both values numeric)", "value": float(n_pairs)},
    {"label": "Rows excluded from the correlation (missing or non-numeric Units or UnitPrice)", "value": float(n_excluded)},
    {"label": "Pearson linear correlation between Units and UnitPrice (comparison, same complete pairs)", "value": pearson},
]
if p_value is not None:
    metrics.append({"label": "Two-sided p-value of Spearman rho (scipy.stats.spearmanr, complete pairs)", "value": p_value})
if kendall is not None:
    metrics.append({"label": "Kendall tau-b between Units and UnitPrice (comparison, complete pairs)", "value": kendall})

for lvl in sorted(work.loc[mask, "Market"].unique()):
    sub = work.loc[mask & (work["Market"] == lvl)]
    if len(sub) >= 3:
        metrics.append({"label": "Spearman rho between Units and UnitPrice within Market = " + str(lvl) + " (complete pairs in that market)", "value": spearman_manual(sub["Units"].to_numpy(dtype=float), sub["UnitPrice"].to_numpy(dtype=float))})
        metrics.append({"label": "Complete Units-UnitPrice pairs in Market = " + str(lvl), "value": float(len(sub))})

result = {
    "method": "Spearman rank correlation on complete Units-UnitPrice pairs (average ranks for ties), computed in Python on the active unfiltered dataset; Pearson and Kendall reported as comparisons.",
    "metrics": metrics[:40],
    "limitations": [
        "Correlation measures association only; no causal direction can be inferred.",
        "Units and UnitPrice are ranked as ordinal/continuous values with average ranks for ties.",
        "The profile reported no missing values, so exclusions are expected to be zero; per-market correlations use small subsets and are less precise than the overall estimate.",
    ],
}
